raw_segments.text: Ye go, he takes her by the palm.
With as little a web as this will lie and snare as great a fly as Cassio.
I will jive thee in thine own courtship.
You say true, tease so indeed.
If such tricks as these strip you out of your lieutenantry it had been better you had not
kissed your three fingers so oft which now again you are most apt to play the Surin.
Very good, well kissed, an excellent courtesy.
Yet again your fingers to your lips.
Would they were clisterpipes for your sake?
